# With PGO, go test compiles a package once for a main package's binary and
# again for its test binary, with the same inputs, and can compile the test
# against one copy and link the other. The linker rejects the build unless both
# copies of a rewritten package are the same archive. A profile with no samples
# is enough to turn PGO on.

cd mkprof
exec go run . $WORK/cmd/bench/default.pgo
! stdout .
! stderr .
cd $WORK

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_LOG=$WORK/log
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_LOG_PKGS=example.com/app/vec
exec go test -toolexec=$LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC ./...
stdout -count=1 '^ok  	example\.com/app/vec	'
stdout -count=1 '^ok  	example\.com/app/cmd/bench	'
! stderr .
cmp log log.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.27.1
-- vec/vec.go --
package vec

func Add(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}
-- vec/vec_test.go --
package vec

import "testing"

func TestAdd(t *testing.T) {
	dst := make([]float32, 9)
	Add(dst, []float32{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9}, []float32{1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1})
	if dst[8] != 10 {
		t.Fatal(dst)
	}
}
-- cmd/bench/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/app/vec"

func main() {
	dst := make([]float32, 4)
	vec.Add(dst, dst, dst)
}
-- cmd/bench/main_test.go --
package main

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/app/vec"
)

// The test imports vec itself, so the test binary gets a PGO copy of vec of its
// own.
func TestAdd(t *testing.T) {
	dst := make([]float32, 4)
	vec.Add(dst, []float32{1, 2, 3, 4}, []float32{1, 1, 1, 1})
	if dst[3] != 5 {
		t.Fatal(dst)
	}
}
-- mkprof/go.mod --
module mkprof

go 1.27.1
-- mkprof/main.go --
// mkprof writes a CPU profile with no samples to the file named by its argument.
package main

import (
	"os"
	"runtime/pprof"
)

func main() {
	f, err := os.Create(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := pprof.StartCPUProfile(f); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	pprof.StopCPUProfile()
	if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
-- log.want --
rewrote 1 loop(s) in example.com/app/vec
rewrote 1 loop(s) in example.com/app/vec
rewrote 1 loop(s) in example.com/app/vec
